issues.problem: Lessons often imply a single showLeds block 'makes the heart beat', leaving kids confused when nothing animates.
issues.fix: Explicitly teach that animation needs at least two different frames shown in sequence with pauses between them.

issues.problem: The pause block value is in milliseconds, but beginners read 1000 as '1 beat' rather than one second.
issues.fix: Annotate the pause block with its millisecond unit and give a concrete '1000 ms = 1 second' reference.

issues.problem: A single showLeds inside forever leaves the same image on screen each pass, so pupils see a static heart and conclude the code is broken.
issues.fix: Show that the displayed image persists until the next showLeds, so two frames plus a pause each are required for a visible beat.

issues.problem: The small/beating-heart frame is frequently drawn with misplaced center pixels, producing a lopsided or non-heart shape.
issues.fix: Provide the exact 5x5 grid for the small heart and let pupils verify it in the simulator before combining frames.

issues.problem: Typical exit tasks only ask pupils to recreate the animation, never checking the underlying 'why two frames' understanding.
issues.fix: Add a predict-and-explain prompt asking why one frame with a pause does not beat.

issues.problem: No stretch activity for faster/slower beats or triggering the beat on a button press, so quick finishers have nothing to do.
issues.fix: Offer a challenge tier using a variable for beat speed and an on-button-pressed block to start/stop.

issues.problem: Very short pauses that look fine in the simulator flicker or appear dim on real hardware due to LED persistence.
issues.fix: Advise a minimum pause (e.g. 100-200 ms) and encourage testing on a physical micro:bit.
